Risk Description: Floating-point precision errors when distributing uneven tax/tip amounts proportionally.
Mitigation Strategy: Implement strict rounding logic. Verify splits using assertion checks (sum(splits) == total).

Risk Description: Concurrent I/O write collisions or data corruption when updating the CSV file rapidly.
Mitigation Strategy: Use synchronous file writing locks. Trigger CSV updates only on definitive state changes (e.g., "Settle" click).

Risk Description: Desynchronization between the React/Streamlit UI state (checkboxes) and the backend debt dictionary.
Mitigation Strategy: Enforce one-way data binding. The UI strictly renders based on the central session_state source of truth.

Risk Description: "Payer" identity becomes mismatched if the user switches active profiles mid-entry.
Mitigation Strategy: Clear draft items and reset form states automatically whenever a user switch event is detected.
